operation: Reuses three supplied spark textures byte-for-byte from the previous runtime. No new visual/audio assets, cropping, painting, resizing or upscaling. Actual quad rotation around each original head pivot, seeded independent spin/drag/gravity/lifetimes, and world-space free flight. Existing smoke, native effect budgets, transparency and camera-space cosmetic drop remain. Normal Lua renderer and camera APIs only.
screenEffects: Short local camera offset shake, restrained screen tint pulse and source-glint red/cyan fringing localized at the impact. Full-frame RGB scene separation and shader colour correction are not exposed to ordinary Lua; the screen treatment is an approximation, without a Java helper, shader replacement, framebuffer access or persistent graphics/climate changes.
